findings.failing_input: Command palette result: campaign tied to a store name with leading/trailing whitespace
findings.expected: setFilters({...filters, store: c.store}) sets store filter to a valid Filters['store']
findings.actual: c.store is read directly from row.storeName without any defensive sanitization. If a campaign's storeName has whitespace or differs from the store selector's canonical option, the resulting filter mismatch silently shows zero results in the redirected tab. Same in the products branch
findings.fix_sketch: Map c.store to one of data.stores (case-sensitive exact match) before calling setFilters; fall back to 'All' with a warning if no match
findings.regression_test_idea: unit test: feed a campaign with a storeName that differs from data.stores by case → assert that perform() either matches it or warns

findings.failing_input: User opens palette around midnight Asia/Jerusalem
findings.expected: 30-day cutoff date stays stable for the open session
findings.actual: cutoff is recomputed in useMemo on every rebuild (no dep on date); if the operator leaves the palette open while the date rolls, the result set silently shifts by one day. Low-impact: palette is short-lived, but worth noting. The Asia/Jerusalem TZ is correctly used
findings.fix_sketch: Either accept the existing behavior (palette is interactive, so the operator-noticed shift is fine) or cache the cutoff in a ref captured at open
findings.regression_test_idea: frozen-clock test rolling Date forward 24h between two useMemo runs and asserting whether cutoff shifted
